traits: Blue-violet to grey-violet cap, often brownish in the centre, 4 to 15 cm, smooth and moist; margin rolled
Deep violet, close gills turning dull brown with age
Stocky stem, 2 to 10 cm, lilac to grey-violet, slightly swollen at the base, with silvery fibrils
White flesh tinged violet at the top of the stem · pleasant, fruity, slightly aniseed smell
Broadleaf and conifer woods, on litter, often in rings · late season, after the first frosts
safetyNote: Some violet webcaps look like it and are very toxic: their spores are rusty brown (its spores are pale pink), they often keep remnants of a cortina and their smell is unpleasant. All red, purple or orange webcaps are to be distrusted.

sources.title: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Mykologie (DGfM), Fachausschuss Pilzverwertung und Toxikologie (2026). Positivliste der Speisepilze, Stand 1. Mai 2026.
